gen-silkscreen-gf-fahkwang: Silkscreen spaces every letter apart, like spaghetti laid out in a row. Fahkwang's faint nib pressure and curves that stop short of closing keep the lo-fi heading from feeling stiff.
gen-silkscreen-gf-figtree: Silkscreen lays its lo-fi, retro letters out like spaghetti, with space around each one you can almost feel. It grabs attention; Figtree, drawn as if with a marker tip, does the reading.
gen-silkscreen-gf-gayathri: Spaghetti-spaced, round letters give Silkscreen its lo-fi, retro look. Gayathri's open-ended curves and mild letterpress-slug modulation give the text a softer, approachable voice, set against rims that match the heading's stems.
gen-silkscreen-gf-gothic-a1: Gothic A1 reads approachable and professional, its splayed c terminal giving otherwise low-contrast letters some quiet character. Silkscreen shouts with joints that never swell; Gothic A1 handles the talking.
gen-silkscreen-gf-gotu: Retro through and through, Silkscreen is monoline and spaced like spaghetti. Gotu then adds light contrast between verticals and curves, with sturdy hairlines and open-mouthed e crossbars that keep the text readable beside it.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: A single flat line weight runs through every glyph of Silkscreen, each one spaced like spaghetti. IBM Plex Sans Arabic takes over with open apertures that read cleanly, making the retro heading feel anchored.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanaga: Silkscreen keeps a constant stroke all the way down while its letters sit spaced apart like spaghetti, lo-fi and retro. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari offers rope-loose curves that never knot.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP feels approachable, every curve ending in a clean, open gap, with nothing fussy about it. Silkscreen supplies the wire-thick retro punch; the body keeps things readable.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Parallel stroke edges run through every curve of Silkscreen, all of it spaced out like spaghetti and unmistakably lo-fi. IBM Plex Sans KR, open at every curve end, carries the reading.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loo: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped is clean, with curves that refuse to close. IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped stays quiet beneath Silkscreen, whose spaced-out strokes have no thin parts to vanish in glare.
